name: Split a mix into vocals, drums, bass, instrumental and other stems
tagline: Hear five stems from a song you already have, then buy the full set
description: Upload an MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A or OGG file of up to 10 minutes and split it into vocals, instrumental, drums, bass and other. Every stem has a free 30-second preview (1 song a day without an account, 5 signed in). A full-length set of stems costs $0.50 per song, or a one-time $5 top-up covers ten songs. No subscription. Use only audio you have the rights to.
